2026-10-28: renderer/renderer.js pins the renderer to the Intel iGPU before Gtk/Gst load
(__EGL_VENDOR_LIBRARY_FILENAMES=mesa, VK_DRIVER_FILES=intel, LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=iHD, nv* decoder ranks 0).
Without it the renderer loaded NVIDIA EGL/Vulkan/CUDA and kept the RTX 4060 awake 100%.
Opt out: HANABI_ALLOW_DGPU=1. Each var is only set if not already in the env.
Original: renderer/renderer.js.orig
2026-10-28: renderer.js loads its GSettings schema from <-P path>/schemas when it isn't
installed system-wide. Before, the user-local renderer ran on hard-coded defaults
(content-fit CONTAIN → black bars, unmuted, enable-va off) and ignored the extension's settings.
